No. OSEC11-020612 24 October 2011 ROSENDO M DIAL, CESO 111 Jail Director DSC Chief, Bureau of Jail Management and Penology Juco Building, 144 Mindanao Avenue, Project 8 Quezon City Subject OPINION ON J02 CAGUISANO'S ENTITLEMENT TO LONGEVITY PAY Dear Jail Director Rosendo M. Dial: DILG Legal Opinion No. 59, Series of 2011 was issued premised on the facts provided by J02 Arnel Caguisano in his letter on whether he is entitled to a longevity pay or not, taking into account the break in the service arising from the suspension meted upon him. The aforesaid opinion also stated that the Legal Service of the BJMP thru Clnsp. Roy Valenzuela rendered an opinion stating that J02 Caguisano was NOT ENTITLED to a longevity pay on account of the 180 day-suspension from office pursuant to the Decision dated 04 March 2010 rendered by then Secretary Ronaldo V. Puno. The Department's opinion merely stated that J02 CAGUISANO IS ENTITLED TO THE LONGEVITY PAY despite the suspension, citing the case of Bongcawel, Aristides Be, Resolution No. 002860 of the Civil Service Commission which ruled that that the ONLY CRITERION for the grant of a longevity pay is the five (5) -year service requirement rendered by virtue of an original appointment validly issued to a uniformed personnel= The law does not distinguish whether the said service requirement be rendered continuously or unbroken. It is a well recognized rule that where the law does not distinguish, courts should not distinguish (Commissioner of Internal Revenue v. Commission on Audit, 218 SCRA 203). In other words, there should be no distinction in the application of a statute where non is indicated ( Lo Cham v. Ocampo, 77 Phil. 636).

12 Thus, it was opined by the Department that the suspension of 180 days should not be considered a break in the service, if only to emphasize that the suspension in service should not be a material consideration in the determination of one's entitlement to longevity pay, The Department never made any comment on how J02 Caguisano's longevity pay would be computed. The issue that was passed upon was WHETHER J02 CAGUISANO WAS ENTITLED TO A LONGEVITY PAY OR NOT, and the Department rendered its view accordingly. Very truly yours, A TY. J US B. Director III LS:55/06 OQUE IV
